skill.name: domain-expertise-template
skill.description: A reusable template for building domain expertise skills with frameworks, principles, process steps, output templates, anti-patterns, and intake questions.
skill.summary: Create structured domain expertise skills from a customizable SKILL.md template.
skill.author: ChaiWithJai

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent structures for reusable domain guidance. This skill provides a customizable template for frameworks, processes, outputs, anti-patterns, and intake questions.
actual_capabilities: Provides a SKILL.md template with frontmatter placeholders.
Structures expertise into framework overview, principles, process, output templates, anti-patterns, and intake questions.
Includes a customization checklist for adapting the template.
Guides authors to define trigger conditions, key terms, examples, and outputs.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code skill authoring workflows.
limitations: It is a generic template and does not contain finished domain knowledge.
Authors must replace placeholders before using it with end users.
It does not validate accuracy, safety, or compliance of the completed skill.
It does not include scripts, tests, or automated publishing tools.

use_cases.title: Build a Specialist Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a repeatable expert workflow into a structured skill with principles, process steps, and reusable outputs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Expertise
use_cases.description: Create a shared format for documenting team practices, quality checks, and intake questions.

use_cases.title: Teach Skill Structure
use_cases.description: Show new contributors how a domain skill can organize scope, terminology, examples, and common mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Domain Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a known domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template to draft a domain expertise skill for [domain]. Include trigger conditions, key terms, three principles, and three process steps.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Team Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert an existing process into skill guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert our [workflow name] process into this domain expertise template. Preserve the real steps, decisions, outputs, and common mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Review and refine a partially completed skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft skill against the template. Identify missing sections, vague guidance, weak examples, and unclear intake questions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Governance-Ready Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for marketplace or internal review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the template to prepare a review-ready domain skill. Include scope boundaries, quality criteria, limitations, anti-patterns, and expected outputs.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for customer onboarding expertise.
output_examples.output: A structured skill outline with onboarding triggers, key terms, principles, process steps, output templates, anti-patterns, and intake questions.

output_examples.input: Review a draft policy analysis skill.
output: Missing trigger conditions for when the skill should activate.
Principles need concrete examples of good and poor analysis.
Intake questions should ask about jurisdiction, audience, deadline, and constraints.

output_examples.input: Standardize our incident review method as a skill.
output_examples.output: A domain skill structure that separates investigation principles, review steps, report sections, and mistakes to avoid.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder with domain-specific guidance before publishing.
Use concrete examples for each principle, process step, and anti-pattern.
Add intake questions that collect scope, context, constraints, and concerns.
anti_patterns: Publishing the template with unchanged placeholder text.
Creating broad guidance without clear trigger conditions or scope boundaries.
Omitting examples, outputs, or anti-patterns that help users verify quality.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps authors create structured domain expertise skills from a reusable template.

faq.question: Does it include completed domain expertise?
faq.answer: No. It provides the structure, but authors must add the specific domain content.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should I customize first?
faq.answer: Start with the skill name, description, trigger conditions, key terms, and core principles.

faq.question: Does it run scripts or commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a documentation template and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: How do I know the completed skill is ready?
faq.answer: Use the checklist, test the triggers, and verify that every placeholder has been replaced.
